text: Kelly Benefits Strategies is the direct sales and marketing division of Kelly & Associates Insurance Group (Kelly Benefits), a company founded by Janet and Frank Kelly that remains family-owned and is guided by their four sons.
short: Kelly Benefits Strategies is a division of the family-owned Kelly & Associates Insurance Group.

source.name: Kelly Benefits: Our History (via the Wayback Machine, capture 2026-02-06)
source.quote: Kelly Benefits Strategies (KBS), the direct sales and marketing division of Kelly & Associates Insurance Group, is one of the largest privately owned benefits brokers and consultants in the country.
source.note: The live page returned HTTP 418 to scripts, so the Wayback capture was checked. The same page states: 'Still family-owned, Kelly Benefits now delivers so much more. Over the years, Janet and Frank’s four sons, Frank III (1986), John (1987), David (1989) and Bryan (1991), joined the business.'

additionalSources.name: I95 Business: Kelly Benefits Celebrates 50 Years of Service, Innovation, and Community Impact
additionalSources.quote: Today, Kelly Benefits remains family-owned and guided by Frank and Janet’s sons—Frank III, John, David, and Bryan—as well as several of their grandchildren.
